name: Pistol squat
goal: 5 strict pistol squats per leg, heel down, no counterweight

stages.name: Squat foundation
stages.work: Full-depth bodyweight squat, heels down; deep-squat holds; knee-to-wall ankle rocks; reverse lunges

stages.name: Single-leg strength
stages.work: Bulgarian split squat, step-ups, 3 s down

stages.name: Assisted pistol
stages.work: Full-depth pistol holding a pole, doorframe or rings

stages.name: Negatives
stages.work: Pistol negatives, 5 s to full depth, two legs to stand
ready: 3 × 5 per leg at 5 s to full depth

stages.name: Full pistol
stages.work: Counterweight held forward (2–5 kg) then dropped; heel flat
ready: 5 strict reps per leg, no counterweight
